career_ladder.note: National Housing Bank (NHB) is the apex statutory financial institution for housing finance in India, wholly owned by the Government of India (Ministry of Finance). Officers join at Junior Management Grade Scale I (JMGS-I) as Assistant Managers across Generalist, Hindi, and IT disciplines, progressing through Middle Management, Senior Management, and Top Executive cadres.

steps.source_label: NHB — Recruitment of Officers in Various Scales Notification / Officer Service Regulations
Government of India Appointment / Statutory Authority

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Assistant Manager (Scale I) in National Housing Bank is conducted in two phases: Phase I Online Examination (Objective 200 marks + Descriptive English 25 marks = 225 marks total, duration 210 minutes) followed by Phase II Interview (50 marks). In the objective test, a negative marking deduction of 1/4th (0.25) mark applies for each incorrect answer.

stages.stage_name: Phase I: Online Examination (Objective & Descriptive Tests)
stages.source_label: NHB — Recruitment Notification (Selection Procedure & Examination Scheme)

papers.paper_name: General Awareness (with special focus on Housing, Banking & Financial Sector)

papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying score required (evaluated only if objective test cutoff is cleared)

papers.paper_name: Personal Interview (NHB Head Office, New Delhi)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum qualifying marks in interview: 50% for UR/EWS, 45% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD

financial_package.note: Assistant Managers (Scale I) in NHB receive compensation in Junior Management Grade Scale I (JMGS-I). Starting basic pay is ₹48,480 under revised banking/financial institution bipartite settlement scales (earlier ₹36,000 in scale ₹36000-1490/7-46430-1740/2-49910-1990/7-63840). Gross monthly emoluments are approximately ₹82,000 to ₹92,000 per month.
financial_package.pay_source_label: NHB — Recruitment Notification (Emoluments & Perquisites of Assistant Manager)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on entry basic pay of ₹48,480 with applicable Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance (or Bank accommodation / leased housing), City Compensatory Allowance, Special Pay, and Special DA; net in-hand accounts for standard defined contribution pension and PF deductions.
official_perks: Bank accommodation or leased residential facility in New Delhi / regional centers
Comprehensive medical facility / reimbursement of hospitalization expenses for self and family
Defined contribution pension scheme under National Pension System (NPS) and Gratuity
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and leave encashment benefits
Concessional loan facilities for housing, car, and computers, plus newspaper and mobile allowances

competition_benchmarks.note: NHB recruits Assistant Managers and officers in various scales annually based on organizational requirements. In the 2024 recruitment cycle, 48 vacancies across various regular and contractual posts (including Assistant Managers) were notified.
